title: A Contact for the Ghost
author: Mara Fairweather
blurb: Emrys Delacroix, a whistle-blower living under four names, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
